note: Inyo County campground in sagebrush along Baker Creek just west of Big Pine, off US-395, with two stocked trout ponds. Many sites are only 20 ft, so pick a longer one. --Claude
summary: Baker Creek (Inyo County): ReserveAmerica INYO 1100011, 43 sites ($14) of which 12 are walk-up only, no hookups, no potable water, vault toilets, bookable year-round (Jan 2027 sites open). Creekside kept, on named sites 24-27 and 34 (30/30/30/25/40 ft) along the creek. Season changed from approximate May-Oct to year-round on the RA rate table and January availability.
flags: WATERFRONT: creekside KEPT (stored, not --AWH). The county map draws sites 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 34 and 35 on the bank of Baker Creek along the west camp road. Esri imagery shows that road and its pull-ins directly beside a ~15-20 m riparian strip with the creek inside it (a few metres wide, so creek not river), around 37.1695,-118.3100 to 37.1712,-118.3083. Nothing is between the pads and the strip; it is an easy walk down. Of those, 24/25/26 (30 ft), 27 (25 ft) and 34 (40 ft) fit a 23-ft rig and are 'Book Now' (sold nightly). 28/29/30/35 are 20 ft walk-up sites. Sites 2-12 sit along the second channel by the entrance, and 13/17 sit by the trout ponds.
